# @motifx-community/ui

> UI components for MotifJS (@motifx/core) on the MotifJS design system. Version 0.1.0-beta.0: a preview, its API may still change before 1.0.

Built on MotifJS (`@motifx/core`): a component is an object, made in JSX or with `new`, whose every prop takes a value or a function (`Bind<T>`); `x-model` binds a value two-way. The look is the design system’s (`@motifx-community/design-system`): five design languages (`data-identity`), light and dark themes, density.

## Start

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, set up Vite, styles, design languages, the kit’s languages

## Get started

- [@motifx-community/ui](docs/home.md): Components for MotifJS that work the way desktop UI does — created when needed, shown anywhere, closed and disposed like windows — drawn from the MotifJS…
- [Showcase: an order screen](docs/showcase.md): An order screen built with the kit, the way a MotifJS app is built: the state and the operations live in a model (`OrderModel`), the page binds to it. The…
- [Design tokens](docs/tokens.md): Five layers. The first four — primitives, the design language's own scales, semantic tokens per theme, density — come from `@motifx-community/design-system`…

## Foundations

- [Control](docs/control.md): The base of every control in the package. It gives each one the same `text`, `enabled`, `visible` and `tabStop`, and the same focus methods, whether the…
- [Keyboard and focus](docs/keyboard.md): The rules every control follows: Tab order, the active control of a container, focus that never falls to `<body>`, `&File` access keys and app-wide shortcuts.

## Buttons

- [Button](docs/button.md): A native `<button>` drawn from the design tokens: three variants, three tones, three sizes, an icon, an `&` access key. It can be a toggle, show that work…
- [ButtonGroup](docs/buttongroup.md): Buttons that belong together: a segmented choice of one or several, or a row of actions. The buttons are the kit’s own, touching by default.
- [Toolbar](docs/toolbar.md): A bar of commands: buttons, toggle buttons, menus and fields in groups between separators. It is one Tab stop and the arrow keys move inside it; items that…
- [MenuBar and ContextMenu](docs/menus.md): A menu bar of an app (File, Edit, View) and the menu that opens on a right-click. Both show the same menu items: submenus, check and radio items, shortcuts,…

## Editors

- [TextBox](docs/textbox.md): A one-line text field with its label, help text and error: placeholder, prefix and suffix, buttons in the box, a clear button, a password that can be shown,…
- [TextArea](docs/textarea.md): A text field of several lines: a box that grows with the text or that the user drags bigger, a character counter, a clear button, Ctrl+Enter to send, and…
- [NumberBox](docs/numberbox.md): A number field: arrow keys, PageUp / PageDown and spin buttons that repeat while held, bounds, a step without float noise, a format for display (currency,…
- [DateBox](docs/datebox.md): A date, a time or both. It is typed in the order of the locale through a mask, or picked from a calendar and a list of times; `min`, `max` and…
- [ColorBox and ColorPicker](docs/colorbox.md): A colour as a field, with a picker in a popup; or the picker on its own. The picker has an area of saturation and brightness, a hue strip, an opacity strip,…
- [Calendar](docs/calendar.md): A month of days to pick a date from, with a year and a decade view to get far quickly. It is the picker of DateBox, and it works on its own.
- [Slider](docs/slider.md): A value picked on a track by dragging a thumb or with the keys: one number, or a range with two thumbs. Steps, marks with labels, a value bubble, a vertical…
- [Rating](docs/rating.md): A row of stars to give a score or to show one, whole or by halves. It is a field: label, help text, rules and `x-model` work as in every field.

- [Switch](docs/switch.md): An on / off switch with its caption: a track with a thumb that slides, an optional on / off text inside or next to it, read-only and required. A native…
- [RadioGroup](docs/radiogroup.md): A set of options of which one is chosen: from plain values, from your own objects or from a live list; one under the other, side by side or in columns;…
- [DropDown](docs/dropdown.md): Picks one item from a list. The field shows the chosen item; the list opens below it with the keyboard or a press, can be searched, grouped and drawn your…
- [ComboBox and Autocomplete](docs/combobox.md): A text field with a list that follows what is typed. The items come from memory or from a data source of the data layer, searched on the server.…
- [Lookup](docs/lookup.md): Picks one row of a table-like list, typically from a data source searched on the server: a customer by its company, contact and city. The field shows the…

## Feedback

- [ProgressBar and Spinner](docs/progress.md): ProgressBar shows how far some work is, as a line or a circle, or that it runs when that is not known. Spinner says "busy, wait": a turning ring, alone or…
- [Tooltip](docs/tooltip.md): A short description shown next to an element: after the pointer rests on it, when it gets keyboard focus, or from code. It can be hovered, Escape hides it,…
- [Toast](docs/toast.md): Short notifications at an edge of the window: four tones, an action such as Undo, a time of their own or none, six positions and a limit on how many show at…

## Display

- [Badge](docs/badge.md): A short text, a count or a dot: in a line of text, or on a corner of a button, an avatar or an icon. A count over its maximum shows “99+”, a count of zero…
- [Avatar and AvatarGroup](docs/avatar.md): Someone’s picture, or their initials, or a person icon, with their presence on its corner. A group stacks or spreads them and counts the ones it does not show.
- [Chip and ChipGroup](docs/chip.md): A short text with an icon or an avatar before it: a filter to turn on, a choice among a few, or something picked that can be removed. A group selects one or…
- [Card](docs/card.md): A surface holding one thing: a picture, a header with an avatar and titles, content and a row of actions. Parts with nothing in them are left out.
- [Skeleton](docs/skeleton.md): The shape of what is loading, so the page keeps its layout while data arrives. Given content, it shows the content in the same place once loading ends.

- [BottomSheet](docs/bottomsheet.md): A panel that comes up from the bottom of the page or of a container and stops at a few heights: a peek, half, full, as tall as its content, or heights of…
- [Drawer](docs/drawer.md): A panel that slides in from an edge of the page or of a container, over the content or pushing it aside. A finger swipes it in from the edge and back again;…
- [ActionSheet](docs/actionsheet.md): A list of commands that comes up from the bottom, made of the kit's menu items and large enough for a finger, with a title, a message and a cancel button…
- [Layout](docs/layout.md): Containers that place controls: `Stack` (a row or a column), `Grid` (rows and columns), `Panel` (a plain box that can scroll), `GroupBox` (a titled frame),…
- [FormLayout](docs/formlayout.md): Lays out the fields of a data object on a grid. Each field gets an editor — by name, or by the type of its value — bound to the object both ways; groups,…

- [Scheduler: Editing](docs/scheduler-editing.md): Appointments are added, moved, resized, copied and deleted with the pointer, the keys and code; every change asks its event first, can wait for a server,…
- [Scheduler: Recurrence and time zones](docs/scheduler-recurrence.md): Appointments that repeat by an RFC 5545 rule, with times left out and occurrences changed apart; a question on what a change reaches; an editor of the rule;…
- [Scheduler: Resources and groups](docs/scheduler-resources.md): Rooms, people and any other kind of resource: they colour the appointments, split the columns into groups (nested, or under each date), say when each one…
- [Scheduler: The appointment form](docs/scheduler-form.md): The appointment form set up without events: which fields, in which order, in groups and tabs; editors of your own; checks per field; fields shown or locked…
- [Scheduler: Timeline](docs/scheduler-timeline.md): A row per resource with the time running along it: a day, a week, a work week or a month. Appointments at the same time stack in their row, and the row…
- [Scheduler: Agenda](docs/scheduler-agenda.md): The coming days as a list: each day with its appointments in time order, a day with none left out.
- [Scheduler: Big data](docs/scheduler-big-data.md): Thousands of resources and appointments: the scheduler builds only what is in view, and lays out only what changed.

- [Scheduler: iCalendar and print](docs/scheduler-icalendar.md): Appointments out to an iCalendar file and back in (RFC 5545), for use with other calendar applications; and the scheduler on paper.

- [DataGrid: Bands and adaptive columns](docs/datagrid-bands.md): A band is a header over several columns (band column): give it a `title` and the `columns` under it — columns and other bands, to any depth.…

- [DataGrid: Selecting by dragging](docs/datagrid-drag-select.md): With `selection: 'multiple'`, press on a row and drag over others: the rows between are selected as the pointer goes, with a frame around them while the…
- [DataGrid: Scrolling](docs/datagrid-scrolling.md): The `mode` prop picks how the rows are reached. Every mode draws only the rows in view from a small pool of rows, so the page never holds one element per row.
